measurements.limit: Only the first sampled native comparison meaningfully improves. Static means are largely unchanged and local maximum differences can increase.

manifest.acceptance: Physical input, menu save/load and rebinding, listening, force-feedback hardware and campaign-wide acceptance remain pending. The adjusted capture script aligns displayed snapshot times; packet identifiers differ and broader retail image parity remains open.
manifest.waveUpdate: Updated engine artifacts only; existing manual profiles and launchers retained. Physical input and listening remain pending.
manifest.feedbackUpdate: Verified engine artifacts refreshed; homes preserved. Installed FFC10 copied to independent test assets. Launch-SP defaults use_ff to 0; optional user-operated checks documented.
manifest.cadenceUpdate: Engine artifacts refreshed after full Windows suite, focused Linux SP tests, production cadence and retail save round-trip checks. Existing manual homes, saves, launchers and settings preserved.
manifest.imageAssessmentCorrection: Full-resolution corridor images agree across GLx/Vulkan/RTX within one channel value. The initial backend-specific contact-sheet assessment is retracted.
manifest.imageMipsUpdate: Engine artifacts refreshed after full Windows suite, Windows/Linux exact mip tests, six controlled GPU comparisons, and stock scene smoke checks. Existing manual homes, saves, settings and launchers preserved.
manifest.startupFrameUpdate: Engine artifacts refreshed after full Windows suite, native startup observations, seven-profile Windows/Linux checks, 66 map starts and retail save round trips. Existing manual homes, saves, settings and launchers preserved.
manifest.compressionControlUpdate: Renderer artifacts refreshed after full Windows suite, seven-profile Windows/Linux cvar checks, SP/Holomatch video restarts and controlled texture-format comparisons. Existing manual homes, saves, settings and launchers preserved.
manifest.alphaCompressionUpdate: Renderer artifacts refreshed after native SP/Holomatch format observations, seven-profile Windows/Linux format checks, video restarts and controlled texture comparisons. Existing manual homes, saves, settings and launchers preserved.

limits: The native fixture covers format selection after component detection, with the lightmap argument off; it does not run the native decoder or alpha scan.
Vulkan/RTX shipping upload paths remain uncompressed. Their retained OpenGL paths are compiled independently in the regression.
Dynamic font atlases, compression opt-outs, lightmaps and explicit sRGB decode retain their previous formats.
Native lightmap and preferred-method controls, localized image differences and broader renderer/campaign coverage remain open.
Physical input, menu save/load/rebinding, listening and force-feedback hardware remain unverified.
Existing asset defects, wider Linux-suite failures and Windows x86 RT-extension limits remain open.

initialFullRun.reason: Documentation was written during the run before its linked evidence JSON existed. Three packaging checks fail for that same missing path; all other Python checks and Meson targets pass.

cleanup: Useful evidence remains in designated project/test directories. Earlier cleanup was rejected automatically as blocked by policy; no repeat cleanup attempted.
